pending.reason: Contested: two defensible behaviors both look correct here, so the case measures nothing and cannot gate. search_rates takes NO cargo argument (searchRatesArgs is origin/dest/mode/ship_date only), so an agent that resolves the lane first and meets the 30,000 kg bound later at calculate_quote is behaving correctly, and an agent that refuses up front is also behaving correctly. Scoring either as a failure asserts a preference rather than a requirement. The tempting fix is adding cargo to search_rates' signature, which would be a contract change made to satisfy an eval and is named as the specific scope-creep risk in hazard H6, so the signature is untouched. Replaced by extraction-absurd-weight-at-quote, which targets calculate_quote where cargoSchema's .max(30000) actually binds, plus extraction-heavy-but-valid-25000kg as the counter-case that stops the prompt passing by clarifying on anything heavy.
runAgentTurn returns the first tool call only (agentLoop.ts:65); a two-search_rates comparison is not expressible until the loop supports multi-call turns — deferred to L5/loop follow-up.
